maes-5.why: Trigonometry builds on algebra and geometry concepts, requiring a good grasp of ratios and functions.

maes-6.why: Calculating area and volume involves applying formulas and understanding spatial reasoning.

maes-7.why: Sketching curves requires visualizing mathematical relationships and graphing skills.

maes-8.why: Working with fractions is essential for many mathematical operations and problem-solving scenarios.

maes-9.why: Determining missing side lengths involves using the Pythagorean theorem and understanding geometric proportions.
